PR title: Add TokenBucket rate limiter
PR description: Adds a small in-memory token bucket so callers can rate-limit outbound requests (needed by the webhook sender in #212).

- Continuous refill, capped at capacity
- Injectable clock for deterministic tests
- Guards against the system clock going backwards

Tests: `npm test` (5 new cases, all passing).
